## Describe the bug

Hello, I’m playing on a Creative world, version 1.21.1, with various mods active, notably Create, Create Aero, Create Craft & Addictions, and Sable.
I’m currently working on a project involving jet engines, and I regularly need to use the diagram to adjust the balance or orientation.
in this contraction, i have a boiler with 2 straw blaze burner, it's the only difference between other configuration not crashing. (so i'm suspecting it's that)

**I’ve encountered several issues:**
- occasional freezes
- The diagram opens without any issues (50% of time)
- The diagram opens, but only the arrows are displayed; the rest of the interface is blank, the game freezes, saves and crashes
- The diagram opens but the buttons in the top right-hand corner do not appear; I have to close and reopen the diagram to refresh it.
- The diagram does not open; the game freezes and crashes

Furthermore, the lack of a visual cue to indicate the direction of thrust is really annoying. 
If you could add in futur, a particle effect (purple?) when holding the wrench to indicate the direction of thrust, it would save a lot of time on projects with many propellers 

i can send you my savegame if it's needed. or the blueprint of this project.
